reasoning: The icon depicts a looping freehand stroke with a touch point dot (standard UI glyph for touch/stylus gestures or scribbling). While useful for niche tasks around trackpad gestures, digital inking, handwriting practice, or signatures, it is abstract enough that many users confuse it with a person swimming, a Japanese character, or a piece of string.
